data.narrative:
ispace is a publicly listed Space & Aerospace company founded by Takeshi Hakamada, having raised $200M+ to date. The valuation universe comprises 5 public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private comparables including Planet Labs, Astroscale, SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Impulse Space—13 total peers across the sector.

Two standard triangulation methods are inapplicable here. Peer-Median benchmarking requires a minimum of three comparables within narrow stage and valuation-tier filters; the dataset contains only 2 same-stage peers and none in adjacent tiers, falling short of the 3-datapoint threshold. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be executed because ispace's revenue is not on file, preventing calculation against the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 23.9x observed across the 6 public-market tickers.

With neither conventional method viable, this analysis cannot produce a defensible triangulated valuation range or point estimate. Deriving value would require either (1) disclosure of ispace's recent revenue or EBITDA figures, enabling P/S or EV/EBITDA application, or (2) expansion of the comparable set to include at least two additional same-stage peers. The sector median multiple and private peer roster are available for reference but insufficient alone to support a quantified valuation conclusion.
